references.text: Moses repeats the Lord's command to the congregation to stay away from the dwellings of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, and the people obey by withdrawing.
Once again the congregation is told to withdraw from danger when the Lord's wrath threatens, a recurring pattern in this narrative.
Lot is urged to leave Sodom before judgment falls, just as Israel must remove themselves from the rebels' dwellings before God's judgment.
The prophet urges the people to go away and remain pure, a principle of separation from uncleanness that applies here as well.
God's people are called to come out of Babylon so as not to share in her sins and plagues, the same principle of separation from judgment.
Paul quotes the OT and urges believers to go out and separate themselves from the unbelievers, a principle of holy separation.
